body.subject: Issue #561: admission weighs measured memory and disk — worker leases carry their seats' measured bytes, swap headroom is capped by the disk that must back it, and a seat-run suite queues durably for the same verify lease a landing gate takes

items.change: Worker admission weighs the memory its seats actually hold: worker lease records carry an optional measured bytes field, the byte budget sums it, and the weight of ONE more worker is the measured mean per worker (measuredWorkerWeightBytes) — an unmeasured fleet admits its first worker weight-free and the measurement accrues with the fleet, so the 39-lease pile-up from the incident now reads as a real budget and the next seat QUEUES durably (FIFO, visible shortfall naming budget/bytes) instead of being admitted against a zero weight
